name: Microgrid island reactive-load estimate
aliases: microgrids Microgrid voltage and reactive-power controls
summary: Associates the monitored island loads with their defined reactive-demand estimate.
description: Associates the monitored island loads with their defined reactive-demand estimate. Voltage and reactive-power control coordinate the AC operating condition of the microgrid resources. A voltage target, reactive-power target and power-factor target represent different control objectives and should have explicit ownership.

In an islanded microgrid, the assigned reference source supports bus voltage while other compatible resources share reactive demand according to the selected control method. Grid-connected operation can use a different objective at the PCC. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Island load measurements” at the input and “Reactive-demand estimate” at the output. Load behavior can change with voltage.
